behaviors_asserted: hc() allows direct values in path segments (e.g., .users['123']) instead of requiring explicit param mapping.
The proxy should detect parameter values in path segments and automatically generate the params object.
Existing param-mapping syntax (e.g., .$get({ param: { id: '123' } })) is preserved for backward compatibility.
Type definitions should support both syntaxes and ensure proper inference of path parameter types.
Query parameters and WebSocket connections continue to be supported with the new path-parameter syntax.
